rationale: All five findings from the second review round are resolved. CR-001 (warning premature): logger.warning moved to inside the inner try, after tools.append(tool) succeeds, and exc_info=outer_e preserves the original traceback. CR-002 (anyOf/oneOf bypass exception handler): _create_model_from_schema now merges branch properties before processing, so tools whose schemas have all-object anyOf/oneOf branches get a model with the merged fields rather than a zero-field model — they no longer silently bypass the exception handler because the model is now properly built. CR-003 (_create_model_from_schema zero-field model): fixed by the branch-property merge in _create_model_from_schema. CR-004 (stale TypeError message): error message updated to mention anyOf/oneOf. CR-005 (enterprise_tool.py side-effect): resolved transitively — _create_model_from_schema now returns a model with merged fields for all-object anyOf/oneOf schemas, so EnterpriseAgentTool is registered with the correct schema rather than an empty one. 27/27 tests pass. Commit format conforms to EPMCDME-####: Description pattern. make ruff passes cleanly.

business_review.criterion: Tools with unprocessable schemas appear in the tool listing with a fallback schema
business_review.notes: _create_tools() catches exceptions and appends the tool with a minimal empty Pydantic schema; the tool is visible in the UI with its name and description intact.

business_review.criterion: Tools with currently-parseable schemas continue to work unchanged
business_review.notes: _create_args_schema() path is unchanged for tools that parse successfully; no regression risk.

business_review.criterion: Tools with all-object anyOf/oneOf top-level schemas get field hints from merged branch properties
business_review.notes: _create_model_from_schema now merges properties from all anyOf/oneOf branches into a flat schema; fields from all branches are preserved (all optional since any branch may apply).

business_review.criterion: Scalar anyOf/oneOf unions trigger fallback path, not a silent empty model
business_review.notes: _is_object_schema returns False for scalar unions; they raise TypeError, triggering the warning + fallback path in _create_tools().

business_review.criterion: logger.warning fires only after fallback tool is appended; exc_info preserved
business_review.notes: Warning moved inside inner try, after tools.append(tool). exc_info=outer_e passes the original exception so the stack trace from the schema conversion failure is preserved in logs.

business_review.criterion: logger.warning is NOT logged when fallback also fails
business_review.notes: If MCPTool() in the inner try also raises, tools.append is never reached, so the warning is never logged — the operator sees only the error, not a misleading 'using fallback schema' message.

business_review.criterion: EnterpriseAgentTool registered with correct schema for anyOf/oneOf inputs
business_review.notes: _convert_args_schema_to_pydantic now receives a model with merged fields instead of a zero-field model; enterprise tools with anyOf/oneOf schemas are no longer silently wrapped with empty args.

business_review.criterion: TypeError message accurately lists valid top-level schema forms
business_review.notes: Message now reads: 'have type object, properties, allOf, anyOf, or oneOf'.

business_review.criterion: No changes to API contracts, response models, or native toolkits
business_review.notes: Only toolkit.py and json_schema_utils.py are changed; no route, model, or non-MCP toolkit modifications.

business_review.criterion: Automated tests cover all fixed scenarios
business_review.notes: 27/27 passing: field-preservation assertions added to test_top_level_anyof_oneof_preserves_fields; test_error_handling_in_tool_creation updated to assert warning is NOT logged when fallback fails.

standards_review.notes: All commits follow EPMCDME-11241: Description format.
make ruff passes cleanly; no violations.
No security concerns; change is scoped to schema parsing and logging within the MCP toolkit.
